description: Election Commission - Announcement made under Sec. 76(a) of the Local Authorities Election Act, that suspension of propaganda activities 48 hours before the poll day
categorisation: This gazette content is specifically about electoral processes and regulations. It contains an announcement by the Elections Commission regarding the suspension of propaganda activities 48 hours before poll day for local authority elections. The content details prohibited activities, campaign regulations, and conditions for campaign offices - all directly related to the conduct of elections under the Local Authorities Elections Act. This fits perfectly within Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) which covers electoral processes, commission directives, and election-related regulations.
